title: Social Responsibilities of Business and Business Ethics

topics.title: Concept of social responsibility and CSR

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the meaning of social responsibility of business and identify socially desirable practices.
Distinguish social responsibility from legal responsibility.
Apply the CSR provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 described in the chapter.

topics.title: Arguments for and against social responsibility

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the arguments in favour of business assuming social responsibilities.
Explain the arguments against business assuming social responsibilities.
Identify the forces that have made business concerned with social responsibility.

topics.title: Kinds of social responsibility and responsibility towards interest groups

concepts.learning_objective: Classify business actions as economic, legal, ethical or discretionary responsibility.
Describe the responsibilities of business towards shareholders, workers, consumers, government and community.
Define environment and pollution and explain why pollution exists.
Identify air, water, land and noise pollution caused by business activities.

topics.title: Pollution control and role of business in environmental protection

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the reasons that make a case for pollution control by business.
Describe the steps a business enterprise can take to protect the environment.
Explain the concept of business ethics and its relationship with law and profits.
Identify the basic elements through which an enterprise fosters ethics.
